```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

borough_levels = c("Bronx", "Brooklyn", "Manhattan", "Queens", "Staten Island")
borough_colors = setNames(
  viridisLite::viridis(length(borough_levels), begin = .15, end = .85),
  borough_levels
)
```

```{r data-prep, include=FALSE}
data("rest_inspec", package = "p8105.datasets")

inspections =
  rest_inspec |>
  mutate(inspection_date = as.Date(inspection_date)) |>
  filter(
    boro %in% borough_levels,
    !is.na(score),
    inspection_date >= as.Date("2012-01-01")
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(camis, dba, boro, cuisine_description, inspection_date, score, grade) |>
  mutate(boro = factor(boro, levels = borough_levels))

monthly_counts =
  inspections |>
  mutate(month = lubridate::floor_date(inspection_date, "month")) |>
  count(month, boro, name = "n_inspections") |>
  arrange(boro, month)
set.seed(1)
score_sample = inspections |>
  slice_sample(n = min(5000L, nrow(inspections)))

top_cuisines =
  inspections |>
  filter(!is.na(cuisine_description), cuisine_description != "") |>
  mutate(cuisine_description = if_else(
  str_starts(cuisine_description, "Latin"),
  "Latin",
  cuisine_description
)) |>
  count(cuisine_description, name = "n_inspections") |>
  arrange(desc(n_inspections), cuisine_description) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  arrange(n_inspections, cuisine_description) |>
  mutate(cuisine_description = factor(
    cuisine_description, levels = cuisine_description
  ))

cuisine_colors = viridisLite::viridis(
  nrow(top_cuisines), begin = .15, end = .85
)
```
Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Inspections per month by borough
Scored inspections since January 2012; one record per restaurant per date. Hover over a line for details; click
a borough in the legend to show or hide it.
```{r monthly-line}
plot_ly(
  monthly_counts,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~n_inspections,
  color = ~boro,
  colors = borough_colors,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines",
  text = ~paste0(
    "Borough: ", boro,
    "<br>Month: ", format(month, "%b %Y"),
    "<br>Inspections: ", format(n_inspections, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections", rangemode = "tozero"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Borough")),
    margin = list(l = 65, r = 20, b = 55, t = 20)
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```
Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Inspection scores by borough
Reproducible random sample of up to 5,000 inspections. Higher scores mean
greater sanitation violations.
```{r score-box}
plot_ly(
  score_sample,
  x = ~boro,
  y = ~score,
  color = ~boro,
  colors = borough_colors,
  type = "box",
  boxpoints = FALSE
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Borough", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = borough_levels
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score (higher = worse)"),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 65, r = 20, b = 65, t = 15)
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```
### Ten most-inspected cuisines
Counts use all retained inspections with a recorded cuisine.
```{r cuisine-bar}
plot_ly(
  top_cuisines,
  x = ~n_inspections,
  y = ~cuisine_description,
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  marker = list(color = cuisine_colors),
  text = ~paste0(
    "Cuisine: ", cuisine_description,
    "<br>Inspections: ", format(n_inspections, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections", rangemode = "tozero"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "", automargin = TRUE,
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = levels(top_cuisines$cuisine_description)
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 150, r = 20, b = 50, t = 15)
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```
